messages:
maria (CS): FYI CedarLane just flagged expansion — DS + Clinical Ops want to onboard next month. they mentioned real-time summary use cases and a big QPS bump on test env. Can we track this as a potential dedicated capacity request?

ryan (CedarLane): hey all — yes, DS will run batch + streaming inference. target: ~6k reqs/min peak in pilot, maybe double if rollout goes well. want dedicated pool if possible.

elaine (AM): noted. renewal in 3 months — this looks like an upsell opportunity but also a risk if we can't meet latency. scheduling enablement sessions with their infra team.

jake (Solutions): key questions: 1) expected sequence length / avg tokens per request? 2) any PII constraints (private deployment)? 3) are they OK with quantized model variants?

ryan (CedarLane): avg seq ~120 tokens, some peaks to 512. PII — patient identifiers, must stay in VPC. quantization ok if quality checks pass.

sam (Platform): capacity-bot: projecting capacity gap for cedarlane-ps1 on dedicated-us-east: current commit covers ~2.5k reqs/min; estimated demand 6k -> shortfall ~3.5k reqs/min. recommend +2 cards (A100 equiv) and enable KV/prefix caching.

capacity-bot: background tasks: looked at their test traffic patterns, 60% of requests share prefixes -> caching should cut token cost 30-40%.

maria (CS): action items: - sam, can you validate whether private (VPC) deployment can add burst nodes by next month? - jake, put together QA checklist for quantized variant and perf targets (p50 < 180ms). - elaine, I'll run renewal healthcheck + exec briefing with CedarLane by EOW.

elaine (AM): i'll sync with Ryan on exec slots. also capturing their feedback on latency vs hallucination tolerance — they prioritize clinical accuracy over latency for Clinical Ops, DS wants faster. potential tradeoff to discuss.

jake (Solutions): i'll draft an eval prompt set and sampling plan to measure quality delta for int8/llm-quant. will include fallback plan to non-quantized model if quality regresses.

sam (Platform): quick note: routing policy should pin Clinical Ops to non-quantized variant and DS to quantized + fallback. will add policy draft to the enablement doc.

maria (CS): thanks. renewal risk flag set to "watch - upsell opportunity". capturing this thread in the account doc and tagging for a CSM+Solutions+Platform enablement runbook.

ryan (CedarLane): appreciated — we'll share test dataset and initial prompts by Wed. excited to move fast. :rocket:
